# Guideline coverage fixture and local observations

The `fixture-guideline-*` IDs, categories, source list and check associations are synthetic
test data, not S-CORE/MISRA identifiers or adopted applicability policy. No proprietary
guideline text is included. Source/license/status declarations remain unverified.

`local-measurement.json` retains genuine Clang-Tidy analysis and its original native probe
and output bytes, imported as `imported_unverified`. The declared automatic association
is structurally covered; manual review and profile/authority gaps remain. The matrix
has zero accepted claims and never changes native source, status or suppressions.

`fixture-manifest.json` is the associated synthetic declaration. Temporary paths remain
historical provenance. Guideline source records and imported output originals are embedded;
full target source bytes and independent packet/compliance replay belong to the later slice.
These fixtures cannot establish real readiness.
